findings.title: Task data can override server no-AI-access protection
findings.evidence: With the server record marked noAiAccess=true, observe.read is denied. Adding action.protectedData with ordinary/noAiAccess=false executes the same stub once.
findings.fix: Resolve classification from trusted server state. Derive the operation from the registered executor/tool. Reject caller classification downgrades; a caller may request stricter protection only.

findings.title: Revocation lacks tenant authorization
findings.evidence: An injected authenticated human security-officer from tenant-b gets HTTP 403 reading acme approval but HTTP 200 revoking it; final state revoked.
findings.fix: Apply tenant/resource authorization to every approval route, including revoke and authorize, before reading or mutating state.

findings.title: Runtime does not enforce the PDP approval count at execution
findings.evidence: Actual approval service has two valid approvers; test PDP requires three; runtime completes upgrade.patch stub. requiredApprovals is not sent to authorizeExecution.
findings.fix: Bind execution to the trusted PDP decision and enforce the greater of its required count and the approval service policy count, with distinct eligible approvers.

findings.title: Approval collection leaks IDs and state without authentication
findings.evidence: Anonymous GET /v1/approvals returns HTTP 200 with the acme approval ID and pending state.
findings.fix: Authenticate the collection endpoint and filter results by server-authorized tenant scope.

findings.title: Published overlay entry points are not executable on Linux
findings.evidence: git ls-files -s reports mode 100644 for apply.sh; README invokes scripts directly and the chain directly executes child scripts. This prevents the documented command on an ordinary Linux checkout. No Linux execution was performed here.
findings.fix: Commit execute bits on shell entry points and verify the documented chain in a clean Linux CI checkout, or invoke Bash consistently at every level.

findings.title: Published tip manifest references missing evidence files
findings.evidence: Of 79 manifest entries, 61 match exact LF Git archive content and 18 evidence/*.log files are absent from Git. Repository .gitignore excludes *.log. Windows CRLF checkout differences were excluded from this finding.
findings.fix: Track intended evidence explicitly or regenerate manifests for the actual published contents; verify from a clean checkout.

findings.title: Windows evidence paths are rejected as outside their module
findings.evidence: Conformance suite: 527 passed, 1 failed. dummy-ok fails C-004 for 14 legitimate evidence paths because native resolved paths are checked against root + slash.
findings.fix: Use platform-aware relative-path containment and reject absolute or parent traversal results.

findings.title: Current main has no automated merge gate
findings.evidence: No root .github/workflows files. GitHub reports main protected=false, rulesets=[], open PRs=[], and only one historical failed Actions run from 2026-09-22. This is not a verification of the repository-level Actions enabled setting.
findings.fix: Add CI for clean assembly, integrity, regression suites and deployment checks; protect main with required checks and independent review.
